user.title: Speedster
user.description: Speedster measures download, upload, latency and jitter against {host}, and records how much data each test spent. Every other knob is available under Configure once the entry exists.

init.title: Speedster options
init.description: The same knobs as settings.ini in the desktop app, with the same defaults and the same clamped ranges.

data_description.startup_delay_seconds: No test runs during this window after Home Assistant starts.
data_description.write_csv: Written to config/speedster/results.csv, in the same format the desktop app uses. Required by the report.

data_description.gate_entity: Leave empty to always test. A scheduled test is skipped while this entity is not in the required state - useful for staying off a metered link or a hotspot.
data_description.gate_state: The state the gate entity must be in, for example on, off or home.

data_description.target_seconds_down: Each direction stops at whichever arrives first, this window or the data ceiling. Raise it for a steadier reading on a noisy link.
data_description.max_bytes_down: Split across the streams. On a fast link this is what stops the test, so raise it there.
data_description.max_test_seconds: Absolute guard against a stalled transfer.

data_description.discard_ms: The opening of a transfer is TCP slow start and reads low, so the larger of this and the percentage is dropped before the rate is computed.
data_description.min_window_ms: Below this total window nothing is discarded - there is none to spare.
data_description.request_bytes_max: A stream issues as many requests as it needs to reach its share.
data_description.retry_count: A throttled request (403, 429, 503) is retried at half the size.

run_test.name: Run test
run_test.description: Runs one speed test immediately, off-schedule.

ignore_gate.name: Ignore gate
ignore_gate.description: Run even when the gate entity would block a scheduled test.

build_report.name: Build report
build_report.description: Regenerates report.html from the log and returns where it was written.
